newsitem.title: GREECE: IPO SUBSCRIPTIONS FOR GREEK SYSWARE JUL 29-AUG 1.
newsitem.headline: IPO SUBSCRIPTIONS FOR GREEK SYSWARE JUL 29-AUG 1.

text.p: Public subscriptions to the IPO of Greek Sysware System Integration SA will take place between July 29 and August 1, the company said in a statement.

Sysware, a computer systems integrator, will issue 300,000 new common registered shares at 1,900 drachmas each to raise 570 million drachmas. Total shares outstanding will be 2.3 million after the completion of its IPO.
It plans to use 50 percent of the IPO proceeds to finance its new 1.08 billion drachma investment programme, the balance to fund working capital.
Sysware, which is 70 percent owned by another parallel market listing Altec , will be listed on the Athens bourse's small-cap parallel market.
Commercial Bank is the lead underwriter for the IPO, with Eurobank, General Bank, Bank of Piraeus, Dorian Bank, Hellenic Securities and National Securities acting as underwriters.

Sysware which was founded in December 1993 has seen its turnover and profits rise continuously ever since. It posted pretax profit of 292 million drachmas in 1996 from 158 million in 1995 on turnover of 2.73 billion drachmas in 1996 and 1.71 billion in 1995.
The company forecasts 1997 pretax profit of 490 million drachmas on sales exceeding 4.5 billion drachmas.
Sysware was awarded the ISO-9001 for system integration services in October 1996.

It has a working relationship and cooperates with strategic suppliers of the international market suchs as IBM, Hewlett-Packard, Microsoft, Compaq, Novell and Oracle, it added. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
